title: docs, books and nested satellite workflows still invoke pre-monorepo PACKAGE names (-p trueno-zram-core, -p presentar-yaml, -p presentar-core, -p trueno-rag-cli, --package presentar-terminal) that APR-MONO renamed to aprender-*
evidence: agy lane G1 (conv a4173992) on #4430 head 4d8e4e356 flagged it; `git grep -E '(-p|--package)[ =](trueno-rag-cli|trueno-zram-(core|cli|adaptive|generator)|trueno-rag|presentar(-[a-z]+)?)'` outside archive/ matches 20 files, mostly crates/aprender-{zram,rag,present}/ README/CLAUDE.md/CONTRIBUTING/book, crates/aprender-present-{core,yaml}/examples doc comments, and crates/aprender-present/.github/workflows/nightly-bench.yml:18. Pre-existing: #4430 renames only [[bin]] targets (no [package] name delta in its diff). Root Cargo.toml dependency alias keys like `presentar-core = { package = "aprender-present-core" }` are valid and not part of this.
ask: rewrite the -p/--package invocations to the aprender-* package names (sed-able; exclude docs/**/archive/ and the alias keys), and consider a guard over -p <name> against cargo metadata package names
